Package com.saicone.gama.util

Class ArrayLabeledList<L,E>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.AbstractList<E>
com.saicone.gama.util.ArrayLabeledList<L,E>
Type Parameters:
L - the type of labels in this list
E - the type of elements in this list
All Implemented Interfaces:
LabeledList<L,E>, Iterable<E>, Collection<E>, List<E>, SequencedCollection<E>
public class ArrayLabeledList<L,E> extends AbstractList<E> implements LabeledList<L,E>
Labeled list implementation backed by an ArrayList.
As specified in the LabeledList interface, most of the methods that modify the list without specifying a label will fail with an UnsupportedOperationException.
